verdict.rationale: The upgrade skill explicitly detects 'global vs vendored install', which implies gstack supports both a user-global install and a vendored, project-local copy (gstack-docs-7). The community describes a git-clone-and-copy install model (gstack-comm-3), and contributor dev mode symlinks into a project-local `.claude/skills/` (gstack-docs-16). However, no install documentation shows how a developer chooses between the two scopes. Missing for 10: first-party install docs describing how to select project-local vs global scope, explicit guidance that vendored files are meant to be committed with the repo, and hands-on corroboration of both install paths.
